title.rendered: How Much Does It Cost to Hire Developers in Singapore

content.rendered:
Whether you are planning to hire dedicated development team in Singapore or another Asian country, it’s important to understand the current state of the country’s IT market, as well as explore the possible alternatives to the chosen destination. As you navigate the costs associated with hiring developers in Singapore, remember to factor in the potential need for specialized roles, such as HTML5 programmers for hire or hire freelance mobile app developer for creating a compelling mobile presence.

In this article, we review IT services in Singapore, how much it costs to hire Singaporean developers, and what alternative options are worth taking into consideration. We’ll discover why more and more international businesses look for software development services in Singapore and compare software development outsourcing Singapore with other markets.

Understanding the Evolving IT Scene in Singapore

Singapore is a throbbing center of technological innovation in the modern world. There is a worldwide reverberation to the success, diversity, and technological prowess of its IT industry.

  • Singapore’s IT sector has an impressive annual growth rate of 6.99%. Strategic investments and forward-thinking legislation are fueling this expansion, revealing a thriving ecosystem that supports and promotes creativity from both well-established businesses and nimble newcomers.
  • Singapore is home to an incredible 16, 000 IT firms. These businesses, which range in size from financial behemoths to nimble e-commerce startups, provide a rich tapestry illustrating the centrality of IT in a wide range of sectors.
  • The ongoing process of digital transformation in Singapore is largely propelled by the nation’s workforce of 200k people who are employed in the field of information technology. This workforce is a primary driving factor behind the change. Because it possesses such a wide variety of competencies, including coding and cybersecurity, the nation is making considerable headway in the digital sphere thanks to these capabilities.
  • The value of Singapore’s technological exports is an impressive $159.9 billion, indicating the notable achievement of the country in this sector.
  • The programming languages PHP,.NET, Lua, Java, and Node.js have all had a big influence on Singapore’s information technology industry, demonstrating their adaptability and creativity in a variety of fields including web development, mobile application development, scripting, and system architecture.

IT Hubs Across Singapore

As we navigate the worldwide landscape, three cities emerge as notable entities, each with specific attributes, average remuneration for software developers in Singapore, and a flourishing community of skilled programmers.

  • Singapore

Situated at the intersection of technological advancements and societal development, Singapore emerges as a prominent hub for digital innovation and progress, hosting a population of some 60,000 software developers who actively contribute their expertise to the digital landscape.

The median monthly income for software developers Singapore is approximately $14,300. 

The salary of a website developer Singapore starts from $3,947 per month, depending on the developer’s level of expertise and the programming language(s) they use.

Depending on factors such as expertise, platform familiarity, and software complexity, app developer Singapore can make $14,750 per month.

  • Woodlands

This city possesses a tranquil allure, it is not lacking in technological expertise. In this verdant environment, software engineers navigate their digital trajectories. The median monthly pay for a software developer in Woodlands is approximately $5,667. Within this nurturing atmosphere, a thriving community of over 8,000 developers engages in the fusion of creativity and code, all set against a backdrop of natural magnificence.

  • Marine Parade

The monthly income for a software developer in the Marine Parade area is roughly $3,465. In this particular setting, a collective of over 12,000 engineers establishes a consistent coding routine, navigating the currents of technological advancements while enjoying the pleasant ambiance of the coastal environment.

Alternatives to Singapore: Popular Outsourcing Destinations

The companies interested in developers for hire in Singapore often do global market research to determine available options and their specifics. The following outsourcing destinations are also popular among businesses that want to hire developers in Singapore:

  • Latin America:
    • Strong points: low rates, large talent workforce.
    • Weak points: limited IT expertise, quality of work, cultural disparities.
  • Asia:
    • Strong points: cheap rates, well-established outsourcing procedures, good command of English. The main player here is India as many Western companies prefer to hire developers in India.
    • Weak points: time zones overlap, cultural differences.
  • Western Europe:
    • Strong points: high level of IT expertise, good command of English (+local languages).
    • Weak points: moderate rates, relatively small IT talent pool.
  • Eastern Europe:
    • Strong points: large and highly-educated talent pool, affordable rates, good command of English.
    • Weak points: economic stability.

Ukraine: Beneficial Alternative to Hiring Dedicated Development Team in Singapore

Among the alternative outsourcing destinations to hiring a dedicated development team in Singapore, Eastern Europe, and Ukraine, in particular, face a rapidly growing demand. 

As per the latest KPMG report, Ukraine is a cost-effective outsourcing destination that can boast of a huge and growing IT talent pool and highly-skilled developers. As mentioned in the recent Deloitte report, a number of US and European organizations have already opened 160+ R&D centers in Ukraine (including IBM, Microsoft, Apple, and Samsung Electronics, to name a few).

Here’s why companies make choice in favor of Ukrainian programmers instead of Singapore developer for hire:

  • Well-known IT expertise and good reputation of Ukrainian developers
  • High education level (14m+ people with higher education, according to the latest KPMG report)
  • Rapidly growing IT talent pool (400,000+ graduates annually, as per the KPMG report)
  • Excellent command of English
  • Convenient location and time zones difference with the US and European businesses
  • Similar business culture and values to European
  • Ukraine complies with data protection rules (GDPR and more)
